subject: 1 Enoch (the Book of Enoch)
about: Data for the Enoch subject of the ancient-texts production core. Data only: no claim in this file is asserted as fact. Figures, artwork searches and search terms that the style engine reads live in styles/enoch_template.json; this file holds the subject knowledge the later phases need (topic words, document and place words, scholars' names, anchor-image seeds, research watch-list) in a form a new subject pack (Jubilees, Dead Sea Scrolls, ...) can copy.

research_watch_list.topic: Which parts of 1 Enoch the Qumran copies contain
research_watch_list.prompt: Check which sections of 1 Enoch are attested among the Qumran Aramaic copies, and whether the Similitudes (chapters 37-71) are among them, before any script line links the Qumran copies to the Son of Man chapters.
Find how scholars date the Similitudes of Enoch and which dates are disputed; state the range and the disagreement, not a single date.

research_watch_list.topic: Chapter 71 and the identity of the Son of Man
research_watch_list.prompt: Check how scholars read 1 Enoch 71, including whether it is considered a later addition, before saying who the Son of Man is.
Check the competing readings of 4Q246 (a messianic figure, a king, another figure) and how the text is dated; label the reading used as interpretation.

research_watch_list.topic: Silence about the Temple's destruction as dating evidence
research_watch_list.prompt: Check who makes the argument that a text which never mentions the destruction of the Temple in 70 CE predates it, what it shows and what it does not, and the standard objections.

research_watch_list.topic: Ethiopian church custody and canon history
research_watch_list.prompt: Find a source for any statement about how long a church has guarded a manuscript, when the book left other canons, or what the Ethiopian Orthodox canon contains; do not state durations or dates without a source and locator.
